boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Moravian spaces for studying, creating, meeting, attending events, and recreation across the North and South campuses.

cards.title: Set up at Reeves Library
cards.subtitle: North Campus · Locust and Monocacy Streets
cards.notes: Choose a carrel, lounge seat, group area, or study room; use the lower-level movable furniture and whiteboards to shape a project session.
cards.short_summary: A library with room for quiet work, group work, and research help.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian says Reeves Library offers study tables, individual carrels, group areas, lounge seating, study rooms, and lower-level movable furniture and whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours may vary by academic term; check Reeves Library before visiting.

cards.title: Make media in the Zinzenko Center
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Reeves Library
cards.notes: Reserve or coordinate use of the study lounge and recording studios when a class project needs audio, video, or a collaborative editing setup.
cards.short_summary: A Reeves Library media-creation and study lounge space.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian identifies the Zinzenko New Media Center as a Reeves Library space with a study lounge plus video and audio recording studios.
cards.source_title: Reeves Library Home Page | Moravian University
cards.access_notes: Listed as reservable through the library’s room-booking service; confirm availability before planning a session.

cards.title: Meet up at the HUB
cards.subtitle: North Campus · student center
cards.notes: Use the student-center building as a starting point for a meeting, campus event, dining stop, or visit to student-life and organization offices.
cards.short_summary: Moravian’s central student-center building for collaboration, events, and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian describes the HUB as centralizing programs and resources for students and as a space for collaboration, meetings, and events.
cards.source_title: Celebrating the Haupert Union Building | Moravian University
cards.access_notes: Building spaces and services have their own schedules and reservation requirements.

cards.title: Catch a large event in the Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Haupert Union Building · dining and multipurpose room
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for programs held here; the room operates as a dining room and converts for large-scale campus events.
cards.short_summary: A HUB dining room that also hosts large campus programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian states that the Pavilion is a dining room and multipurpose space for many large-scale events on campus.
cards.access_notes: Dining and event access depends on the current schedule; verify the event details or dining availability.

cards.title: Look for a speaker or performance at Prosser
cards.subtitle: Haupert Union Building
cards.notes: Use the event calendar to find a guest speaker or small performance, then confirm whether the specific program is open to attendees.
cards.short_summary: A 275-capacity HUB event space for speakers and small performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian describes Prosser Auditorium as a 275-person event space suited to guest speakers and small performances.
cards.access_notes: Event admission and availability are determined by each program.

cards.title: Pause on the HUB Portico
cards.subtitle: Behind the Haupert Union Building · overlooking Makuvek Field
cards.notes: Use the covered outdoor overlook as a brief between-class stop, especially when an activity or game is taking place on Makuvek Field.
cards.short_summary: A covered HUB overlook facing Makuvek Field.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian identifies the Portico as a HUB space at the back of the building that overlooks Makuvek Field.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access may be affected by weather or scheduled events.

cards.title: Watch or join activity at Makuvek Field
cards.subtitle: Main Street Campus · North Campus
cards.notes: Check recreation and athletics schedules for field activity; the central field hosts several varsity teams as well as intramural sports and other activities.
cards.short_summary: A central North Campus field used for varsity and intramural activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian says John Makuvek Field is home to field hockey, lacrosse, and soccer, plus a variety of intramural sports and other activities.
cards.source_title: Brilliant Students and Athletes | Moravian University
cards.access_notes: Field use is scheduled; participate only through the relevant team, club, or recreation program.

cards.title: Work out at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Breidegam Field House · North Campus
cards.notes: Bring your Moravian ID and choose cardio, strength, free-weight, or core equipment; the facility is open to students, faculty, and staff.
cards.short_summary: A 10,000-square-foot campus workout space inside Breidegam Field House.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian states that its Fitness Center in Breidegam Field House is open to all students, faculty, and staff and includes cardio equipment and weight areas.
cards.source_title: New Student Guide to Campus Life | Moravian University
cards.access_notes: Bring a valid Moravian ID and check the fitness center’s current operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Bring a draft to the Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Zinzendorf Hall
cards.notes: Reserve an in-person appointment for feedback on anything from rough notes to a finished draft; ask about a Zinzendorf Hall or Reeves Library meeting.
cards.short_summary: Peer writing support for projects at any stage of development.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian says the Writing Center is on Zinzendorf Hall’s second floor, staffed by trained Moravian students, and supports writing from rough notes through finished drafts.
cards.access_notes: Appointments are recommended; walk-ins are accommodated when possible.

cards.title: Book a quantitative-support session
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the Sally Breidegam Miksiewicz Center for Health Sciences
cards.notes: Book ahead when you want one-on-one or small-group peer tutoring for an introductory math or quantitative course; bring the assignment or questions.
cards.short_summary: A peer-tutoring space for Moravian’s 100-level math and quantitative courses.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian states that the Quantitative Resource Center offers individual and small-group assistance from trained undergraduate peer tutors for 100-level math and quantitative courses.
cards.access_notes: Use Moravian’s WConline scheduling platform to review availability and book in advance.
